title: CDP request futures retained after timeout
evidence: Pending map insertion precedes send and wait_for; only receiving matching reply pops it. No finally cleanup.
trigger: Repeated requests time out or ws.send raises without replies.
impact: Pending map grows without bound for lifetime of page.

title: Navigation retains a listener on every call
evidence: navigate registers _on_load, on appends listeners, and no path removes it.
trigger: Repeated navigate calls.
impact: Unbounded callbacks/futures and linear event processing growth.

title: Browser launch timeout leaves browser process alive
evidence: launch returns False on endpoint timeout; __aenter__ raises and __aexit__ is never entered.
trigger: Browser process starts but DevTools readiness fails.
impact: Browser child and profile remain until explicit close or process teardown.

title: Give each render a private source-embedding file
evidence: TEMP_EMBEDDINGS_PATH is the constant /tmp/c5_source_embeddings.npz at 103; every prepare call overwrites it at 735. Worker mode reloads that global path at 1177-1193 rather than a path tied to its parent render.
trigger: Two face-swap processes overlap while one prepares identities and the other starts its workers.
impact: Workers can load the other render's source and target identities, producing the wrong face replacements and mixing biometric data between jobs.

title: Preserve audio offset when rendering a frame subrange
evidence: The rendered video starts at range_start (969-983), while audio extraction at 950 reads the entire input and final mux at 1067-1075 uses that untrimmed audio without a seek or offset.
trigger: A caller supplies --start-frame > 0 to render a subrange of a video with audio.
impact: The output shows the chosen later frames paired with audio from the beginning, producing systematic audio/video desynchronization.

title: Paste enhanced image patches when the ellipse mask is selected
evidence: In process_image_pipeline the enhancer branch computes ready_512 at 840-861, but updates res only inside if bisenet_sess is not None at 864-882. The fallback paste is the else for enhancer at 883, not the mask condition.
trigger: An image render uses --mask ellipse with an enabled enhancer (including defaults), or BiSeNet is unavailable.
impact: The enhanced face is never pasted into res; the command saves the unchanged image and prints DONE. Video mode has an ellipse fallback at 512-519, but image mode lacks it.

title: Reject expert slices larger than the configured active budget
evidence: Eviction loop runs only while _prefetched_keys is nonempty; lines 177-180 append a slice and increment bytes even if that single byte_length exceeds max_active_ram_bytes.
trigger: Configure a 1 KiB budget and a slice of 2 KiB, then prefetch it into an empty pool.
impact: Internal active_resident_bytes exceeds the configured ceiling immediately. The counter already fails its advertised bound; actual RSS is not measured or certified here.

title: Read path copies complete expert outside active-byte accounting
evidence: read_expert_bytes slices mmap and returns bytes without testing max_active_ram_bytes or changing _active_resident_bytes; accounting is confined to prefetch_layer_experts.
trigger: Call read_expert_bytes for a large slice without prefetching, or retain repeated results.
impact: Allocates expert-sized byte buffers beyond the accounting/budget policy and contradicts zero-copy/strict-RAM claims. No measured hardware ceiling is asserted.

title: Shared /tmp prompt queue follows attacker-controlled symlinks
evidence: QUEUE_FILE is fixed /tmp/moskv_fx_queue.json (181); exists/read_text/write_text follow symlinks with no owner or O_NOFOLLOW checks.
trigger: Another local user precreates this predictable pathname as a symlink to a file writable by host user; user invokes --enqueue.
impact: Host overwrites target file with JSON under its own privileges; same shared queue also permits prompt injection. No runtime exploitation performed.

title: Concurrent prompt producers and consumers lose FIFO updates
evidence: enqueue_prompt and get_next_prompt independently read JSON, modify a list, and write whole file at lines 195 and 206 without locking or atomic replacement.
trigger: Two --enqueue processes overlap, or READY consumes while CLI enqueues.
impact: Last writer loses newly enqueued prompts or restores consumed prompts; readers can see partial JSON and reset queue.

title: Energy and enstrophy truncate squared i64 values to u64
evidence: discrete_enstrophy and discrete_kinetic_energy square in i128 then cast each square to u64 before summation (379,384).
trigger: Form containing a value 4294967296 (2^32).
impact: Its square 2^64 truncates to zero, returning zero energy/enstrophy for a nonzero field; larger sums also overflow u64. Pure arithmetic counterexample, no execution.

title: Physical grid spacing absent from numerical RHS
evidence: Taylor-Green initializer stores point velocities (679,685), grid_spacing_h is 2*pi/n (650), but compute_vorticity returns unscaled d1 differences (703) and compute_rhs uses unscaled curl and curl-adjoint without 1/h or 1/h^2 (796-802).
trigger: Run the stated [0,2pi)^3 velocity simulation at two mesh resolutions with same physical viscosity.
impact: Advection and diffusion rates scale with resolution instead of the configured physical PDE; CFL uses physical h while RHS uses lattice differences. Limited to code discretization consistency.

title: Generated temporary variables collide with circuit inputs
evidence: new_var emits v0, v1, ... without reserving circuit parameter names; compile inserts parameter names verbatim (44-50), and generated Rust uses var_<name> for both inputs and gate outputs (130-144). Grammar accepts v0.
trigger: Compile a circuit with public v0 and statements let x = 1; assert(v0 == x); the first constant output is also v0.
impact: The emitted witness declaration shadows the public input variable and the assertion becomes constant==constant, leaving the intended public-input assertion unenforced.

title: Packet packing silently truncates sender and recipient lengths
evidence: Sender/recipient byte lengths are cast to u16 at 29-30 while complete strings are copied at 35-36; unpack requires raw length to match truncated lengths at 78-80.
trigger: Call pack with a sender or recipient whose UTF-8 encoding exceeds 65535 bytes (API has no documented limit validation).
impact: pack returns Ok with a packet its own unpack rejects; callers lose round-trip correctness instead of receiving an explicit size error.

title: Reject oversized content or return the exact bytes that were filtered
evidence: evaluate_payload truncates only its local text variable then can return passed=True with truncated=True. browser_agent.py:109-135 accepts passed, stores raw_payload, attests raw_payload and returns raw_payload.
trigger: A fetched payload has an acceptable first MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES characters containing an anchor, followed by content that the filter would reject.
impact: The unexamined suffix is emitted and cached as VERIFIED_AND_ATTESTED; this is a demonstrated source-level consumer mismatch, not a claim about OS containment. Reject oversize data or propagate a filtered payload.

title: PSD check accepts indefinite residual matrices
evidence: Only leading minors m_xx, det(M[:2,:2]), det(M) are constrained nonnegative (106–115); sat is labeled VALID_PROOF (120–126).
trigger: Use lambda_max=0, diagonal strain=(0,1,1), off-diagonal strain=0. Residual diag(0,-1,-1) has all three checked minors zero.
impact: Returns VALID_PROOF although w=(0,1,0) violates the stated quadratic bound. Positive semidefiniteness requires all principal minors, unlike the positive definite leading-minor criterion.

title: Concurrent sign-offs can fork the audit hash chain
evidence: register_sign_off reads the latest digest before the INSERT transaction; verify_ledger_integrity requires every row to reference the immediately preceding row.
trigger: Two VerificationGate connections using the same database read the same latest digest before either inserts.
impact: Both inserts can commit with the same predecessor; subsequent integrity verification rejects the otherwise legitimate audit chain.

title: Aeon verifier proves individual blocks without checking their connecting states
evidence: The emission loop proves runAeon(initial_i, events_i)=final_i independently; it never emits or checks final_i=initial_(i+1). main labels success as a formally verified chain (180–182).
trigger: Supply valid AeonBlock values whose adjacent final and initial states differ to verify_aeons.
impact: Successful Lean verification does not establish the advertised cross-block causal continuity. The included generator happens to supply connected states.

title: Crash harness cannot detect committed transactions with zero effects
evidence: Worker commits the database before writing effects.log (191-208). Boundary 5 pauses only after the effect sync (211-213), leaving the commit/effect gap untested. Forensic invariant 2 iterates only effects_after_phase2 (470 onward), not committed ledger rows; replay rejects every COMMITTED nonce before checking its effect (258-262).
trigger: A worker terminates after tx.commit() and before writing its effect, or an effect write fails after the commit.
impact: A committed entry can retain zero effects and replay will not repair it; the claimed committed=>exactly_one_effect audit does not count this loss.

title: Advertised 90-second polling bound does not bound network reads
evidence: Both urlopen calls at lines 51 and 68 omit timeout; the elapsed-time condition at 89 executes only between calls. A stalled response can block inside urlopen/read past the deadline.
trigger: The remote endpoint stalls during connection, response headers or body while run_fsm is polling.
impact: The PoC can hang indefinitely instead of enforcing its declared 90-second bound.

title: Create a private temporary directory before writing and executing the demo
evidence: SESSION_HASH derives from Bash RANDOM (line 16); the script uses mkdir -p on a predictable /tmp path, writes main.rs there, builds quasar_engine, writes retrovirus.flac with -y and finally replaces TARGET_FLAC (lines 24-81).
trigger: Another local principal precreates one of the limited candidate temporary directories or symlinks before this demo runs.
impact: The demo can follow preexisting filesystem objects when writing sources/output and executing its built artifact. Use mktemp -d with a private directory rather than accepting a preexisting shared /tmp path. This is an example-script local filesystem issue; no script was executed.

title: Mail migration deletes records belonging to unrelated subdomains
evidence: The zone-wide records list is filtered only by MX type or TXT content v=spf1 (48–58); replacement records target only domain= babylon60.com (62–67).
trigger: Zone includes MX or SPF records for a delegated mail subdomain in the returned records page.
impact: Migration deletes those subdomain mail records and never restores them, disrupting unrelated mail routing and sender authorization.

title: Symlink depth validator accepts three or more parent traversals
evidence: The stated contract requires exactly two levels; the predicate checks only that the first two path components are .. and never rejects a third. audit_symlinks directly consumes this predicate.
trigger: A repository symlink has target ../../../other-project/file.
impact: The auditor returns no violation for a target outside the documented sibling depth and can print a false conformance result.

title: State monitor commits unrelated staged changes
evidence: git_sentinel_commit runs git commit without path restriction on existing index, then c5_real_colapso amends at 270; _git ignores return codes and disables signing, commit skips hooks.
trigger: Run monitor with unrelated staged changes present.
impact: Unrelated changes are included in automatic commit/amend without review; failed git commands can still be reported as completed.

title: Do not certify empirical survival from keyword templates
evidence: Every extract_meta branch selects preset SURVIVE postulates; metrics use line count and unique word ratio. Output unconditionally declares POPPERIAN_SURVIVED and claims empirical scrutiny at line 96, with no experiment or source verification.
trigger: Process any input post matched by the batch slice.
impact: Generated audit documents present predetermined assertions and heuristic scores as checked evidence.

title: Bounded-memory test asserts storage growing linearly with agents
evidence: C5SwarmSimulation appends one16-character digest per agent into wal_log; test validates total_payload_bytes==200*16 while naming this strict O(1) bounded memory.
trigger: Use this benchmark/test as evidence for constant total memory while increasing num_agents.
impact: Passing test measures fixed per-record size while total retained state is O(N), supporting an incorrect benchmark conclusion.

title: Port-53 filtering also removes the documented TLS port 5349
evidence: Both examples use !url.includes(':53'); ':5349' contains ':53'. The same document recommends turns:turn.cloudflare.com:5349?transport=tcp.
trigger: Copy either filter into TURN credential setup.
impact: The filter silently discards the TLS fallback endpoint on port5349.

title: Commit linter inspects working tree instead of staged bytes
evidence: Names come from git diff --cached (8), but grep reads "$FILE" in working tree (19–42). Loop also word-splits filenames (17).
trigger: Stage a violation and remove it only in the working tree, or stage a source filename containing spaces.
impact: The advertised precommit gate can approve staged violations or skip their real path; no active hook integration is asserted.

title: Polymeter selection is ignored by the generator
evidence: createDialog exposes a fixed-bar versus continuous polymeter mode; apply forwards it, but generate_euclidean never reads mode and always uses BAR // n for both layers.
trigger: Choose Polimetro Continuo in the dialog.
impact: The example produces the same fixed-bar timing as the other selection.
